notes.title: 🛠️ Patch 1.04 now available 🛠️
notes.notes:
Hello Earth Defenders,

A new patch for UFO ROBOT GRENDIZER - The Feast of the Wolves has just been released! Here is what it brings:

[b]Art Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies death visual effect issue
[*] LOD adjustment
[*] Missing boat trails
[*] Spazer skin in cinematics
[*] Unwanted water visual effect
[*] Various environment art issues
[/list]

[b]Cutscenes Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Fui Fui animation in level 7
[*] New Daisuke garage animation
[*] Various cinematics issues
[/list]

[b]Design Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Slowed credits transition to dialog
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] Electric towers colliders
[*] Fix level 7 collider boss arena
[*] Issue causing multiple energy bars to be consumed on heal
[*] Issue when opening a chest at the moment of getting new resources
[*] Issue with Koji in hub
[*] Reduce Axe rush attack distance
[*] Region quest markers disappearing after death
[*] Reset skin on new game
[*] Rocket Shmup hitbox fixes
[*] Unlock loot on completing all Vega base
[*] Various issues concerning the first forge
[/list]


[b]Localization Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Arabic level name on right in loading screen
[*] Arabic subtitle adjustments
[*] Japanese text added
[*] Updated scripts in various languages
[/list]

[b]Sound Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Adding new music in credit playlist
[*] Missing mission music in some cases
[*] Music may randomly stop after a quest
[/list]

[b]System Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] Save on rebinding
[*] Stutter reduction
[*] Various crashes fixes
[*] Various performance optimization
[/list]

[b]UI/Options Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Bal Bal disappearing in some cases
[*] Extend UI item popup width
[*] Fixed instruction UI missing F on keyboard
[*] Fixed item name being leftmost in notification popup UI
[*] Mouse cursor issue on save selection
[*] Removing not supported screen resolutions
[*] Update HUD on resolution change
[*] Update menus on resolution change
[*] Update window placement on resolution change
[/list]

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch 1.02 now available 🛠️
notes.notes:
Hello Earth Defenders,

A new patch for [i]UFO ROBOT GRENDIZER - The Feast of the Wolves[/i] has just been released! Here is what it brings:

[h1]UI/Option[/h1]
[list][*]Incorrect Icons displayed for prompt
[*]Limiting the freezes when an enemy spawn
[*]Game over text not displayed in some languages
[*]OS language detection
[*]Dialog Layout fixes
[*]Fixed Dizer Screw Punch and Double Harken inversion in UI
[*]Incorrect display of collectibles count[/list]

[h1]Localization[/h1]
[list][*]Arabic Fixes (line break, missing text, shadows)
[*]Arabic Asrec update
[*]Arabic attacks and cutscenes slightly louder
[*]Italian Asrec update
[*]German change to Grendizer's name (became "Goldorak")
[*]Arabic voicelines correction
[*]Missing advanced menu options translations on PC
[*]Missing subtitles in various dialogues
[*]Arabic voicelines mix improvement
[*]Update to Arabic localization credits
[*]Arabic UI improvements[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list][*]Save system issues
[*]Interactions in HUB not working
[*]Hand Beam not working correctly
[*]Missing music triggers
[*]Audio settings not saved
[*]Various Incorrect respawns after death
[*]Various bossfights issues
[*]Destroyers and forges freezing
[*]Grendizer frozen/blocked in various situations
[*]Various Collider Issues
[*]Unwanted slow-motion effect
[*]Missing saucers in some Spazer levels
[*]Incorrect enemies spawns
[*]Disable dodge during perfect dodge
[*]Fixed Balbal stuck after first death
[*]Camera issue during hits
[*]Fix heal stutter
[*]Spazer crosshair jitter fix
[*]Fix flow at the end of level 6[/list]

[h1]Bonus Mission DLC[/h1]
[list][*]Popup to guide player when Mission becomes playable
[*]Popup to allow player to refuse launching the mission
[*]DLC unlock and relock (eg. after a refund) behavior is fixed[/list]

[h1]Art[/h1]
[list][*]Footsteps issue mismatch ground and water
[*]Missing VFX on bosses
[*]Better flower visuals overall
[*]Shmup NME missing beam FX or not shooting
[*]Tree rendering causes heavy camera shake
[*]Missing Trees in several levels
[*]Shmup 2 grass issue[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]Arabic item count display issues
[*]Sequences before regions can be replayed by using radio tower in R04 and R07
[*]Grendizer's fist is missing during BalBal Finisher cutscene
[*]Fix Spazer 4 vegetation
[*]Incorrect respawn at second time doing DLC mission
[*]Spazer missing during intro cutscene Z08 at second time doing DLC mission
[*]Music during the Gin Gin fight was disabled until the Finisher
[*]Fix collider level 2[/list]
